products.name: ALX2004 (EGFR-targeted Antibody-Drug Conjugate)
products.description: A novel antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) targeting EGFR, developed in-house, consisting of a matuzumab-derived EGFR antibody, a proprietary topoisomerase I inhibitor payload, and a stable linker. products.description: Recurring software services providing ongoing access to advanced analytics, algorithmic updates, fleet management, and cloud-based data insights for deployed vision-based monitoring systems, typically sold as multi-year subscriptions after initial hardware deployment.

products.description: Professional services for integrating vision-based sensor solutions into customer platforms, developing new applications and use cases, and customizing system architecture for specific industry or client requirements, including proof-of-concept and demonstration projects.

products.description: Software-enabled services for workflow automation, document digitization, content management, and data extraction from physical and digital documents, delivered via cloud-based platforms and professional services.

products.description: Comprehensive IT management services including help desk, remote and on-site technical support, infrastructure monitoring, patch management, network administration, backup, disaster recovery, and IT advisory, delivered under service level agreements.

products.description: Design, implementation, and management of network and cybersecurity solutions, including firewall and VPN deployment, endpoint protection, threat detection, vulnerability assessments, and continuous monitoring, delivered through engineering and consulting services.

products.name: Infrastructure and Cloud Solutions
products.description: IT infrastructure and cloud services including server and storage design, virtualization, hybrid and multi-cloud architecture, migration, and ongoing optimization, with licensing and support for Microsoft 365, Azure, and related platforms, delivered via professional services and partner ecosystem.

products.name: Customer Financing Solutions (XFS)
products.description: Lease financing for Xerox equipment and solutions, offered directly or through channel partners, enabling customers to acquire technology via bundled lease agreements, managed through a dedicated global financing business.

products.description: A suite of proprietary, AI-powered advertising solutions that leverage large language models to identify, target, and activate audiences for brands and agencies across digital channels. products.name: Advertising Platform Integrations
products.description: Strategic integrations with large advertising platforms and consolidators, providing scalable, AI-enhanced audience targeting, ad quality, and compliance solutions. Delivered via software integrations and APIs, optimized for high-volume, automated digital advertising environments.

products.name: Publisher Monetization Services
products.description: Services that supply advertisements to website and mobile app publishers, enabling them to monetize their digital properties. Delivered through proprietary ad-serving technology and partnerships, requiring integration with publisher platforms and ongoing ad quality management.

products.name: Acclaim CI (Fully Implanted Cochlear Implant)
products.description: A fully implanted cochlear implant system for adults with severe-to-profound sensorineural hearing loss, leveraging an implanted piezoelectric sensor in the middle ear to capture sound, with all components (sound processor, power source) implanted. Requires surgical implantation and is delivered through regulated medical device channels.

products.name: Esteem FI-AMEI (Fully Implanted Active Middle Ear Implant)
products.description: A fully implanted active middle ear hearing device for moderate to severe sensorineural or mixed hearing loss, using an implanted sensor to absorb mechanical energy from the ossicular chain and directly stimulate the cochlea. Requires surgical implantation and is delivered as a regulated medical device.

products.name: Title Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies that protect property owners and mortgage lenders against losses from defects in title to real estate, issued through both direct operations and independent agents. Requires regulated underwriting, title searches, and claims management, delivered via a large national network of offices and agents.

products.name: Escrow and Title-Related Services
products.description: Services supporting real estate transactions, including escrow, closing, trust activities, trustee sales guarantees, recordings, reconveyances, and related administrative functions. Delivered through in-person and digital processes, often bundled with title insurance.

products.description: Home warranty contracts that provide repair or replacement coverage for home systems and appliances, typically sold alongside real estate transactions. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure and claims management.

products.name: Mortgage Transaction Services
products.description: Services facilitating the production and management of mortgage loans, including title-related services, default management, and technology-enabled transaction support. Delivered through subsidiary ServiceLink Holdings, LLC, using both human labor and digital platforms.

products.name: Annuity Products
products.description: A broad portfolio of annuity products including fixed indexed annuities (FIA), registered index-linked annuities (RILA), fixed rate annuities (including multi-year guarantee annuities), and immediate annuities. These are manufactured and distributed through retail and institutional channels, requiring significant financial capital, regulatory compliance, and investment management.

products.name: Life Insurance Products
products.description: Indexed universal life (IUL) insurance and previously sold universal, term, and whole life insurance products, providing death benefits and cash value accumulation. Requires regulated insurance operations, actuarial expertise, and distribution through agents and financial institutions.

products.name: Pension Risk Transfer Solutions
products.description: Group annuity contracts that assume pension obligations from defined-benefit plan sponsors, providing guaranteed lifetime income to plan participants. Delivered through institutional sales, requiring actuarial, investment, and administrative capabilities.

products.name: Institutional Funding Agreements
products.description: Funding agreements issued to institutional clients, including through funding agreement-backed notes (FABNs) and the Federal Home Loan Bank, providing fixed or variable interest payments in exchange for upfront premiums. Requires financial capital, investment management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: CRISPR-based Gene-Edited Cell Therapy for Hemoglobinopathies (CASGEVY)
products.description: An ex vivo CRISPR/Cas9 gene-edited autologous cell therapy for severe sickle cell disease (SCD) and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia (TDT), manufactured by editing a patient’s hematopoietic stem cells outside the body and reinfusing them after conditioning. Requires specialized manufacturing and regulated clinical infrastructure.

products.name: In Vivo CRISPR-based Gene Editing Therapies
products.description: Therapeutic programs delivering CRISPR/Cas9 or proprietary SyNTase gene editing technologies directly to target tissues (primarily liver) using lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery, aimed at treating cardiovascular, metabolic, and rare genetic diseases. These are manufactured as injectable formulations and require advanced delivery and regulatory oversight.

products.name: siRNA-based Therapeutics for Cardiovascular and Thromboembolic Diseases
products.description: Clinical-stage therapies using double-stranded, long-acting siRNA molecules to silence disease-related genes (e.g., Factor XI for anticoagulation), developed in collaboration with Sirius Therapeutics. Delivered via subcutaneous injection, these products are manufactured using nucleic acid synthesis and require regulatory compliance for biologics.

products.name: Allogeneic CRISPR Gene-Edited CAR T Cell Therapies
products.description: Next-generation, healthy donor-derived allogeneic CAR T cell therapies for autoimmune diseases and oncology, manufactured by multiplex CRISPR/Cas9 editing of T cells to enhance potency, persistence, and immune evasion. Produced at GMP facilities and delivered as cell infusions for clinical use.

products.name: Regenerative Medicine: Gene-Edited Beta Cell Replacement for Type 1 Diabetes
products.description: A deviceless beta cell replacement therapy consisting of unencapsulated precursor islet cells derived from induced pluripotent stem cells, gene-edited ex vivo to promote immune evasion and cell fitness, for the treatment of Type 1 diabetes. Manufactured using stem cell and gene editing technologies, delivered via direct administration.

products.name: Gene Editing Platform Licensing and Partnerships
products.description: Licensing of proprietary CRISPR/Cas9 and related gene editing technologies to external partners (e.g., Vertex) for the development of gene-based therapeutics in areas such as cystic fibrosis, Duchenne muscular dystrophy, myotonic dystrophy type 1, and diabetes. Revenue is generated through upfront payments, milestones, and royalties.

products.name: ecDNA-Directed Therapeutics (ecDTx)
products.description: Novel, orally administered small molecule drugs designed to inhibit cellular machinery essential for extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) function in oncogene amplified cancer cells. These therapeutics are discovered and developed using proprietary drug discovery methods and are delivered as targeted therapies for cancer patients, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: BBI-940 Kinesin Degrader
products.description: A novel, oral, selective small molecule degrader targeting a kinesin protein essential for ecDNA segregation during mitosis in cancer cells. Manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered orally, BBI-940 is in clinical development for specific subtypes of breast cancer and is intended for use as a single agent or in combination with other therapies.

products.name: BBI-355 CHK1 Inhibitor
products.description: A novel, oral, selective small molecule inhibitor of checkpoint kinase 1 (CHK1) designed to target replication stress in oncogene amplified cancers. Developed through proprietary drug discovery and delivered orally, BBI-355 was evaluated in clinical trials but is no longer being actively developed.

products.name: BBI-825 RNR Inhibitor
products.description: A novel, oral, selective small molecule inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) designed to target ecDNA assembly and repair in oncogene amplified cancers. Developed through proprietary methods and delivered orally, BBI-825 was previously in clinical development but is no longer being advanced.

products.name: ecDNA Diagnostic Assay (ECHO)
products.description: A proprietary diagnostic assay developed to detect ecDNA in patient tumor samples by analyzing genomic data from next generation sequencing (NGS) tests. This diagnostic is used to identify patients most likely to benefit from ecDTx and is delivered as a laboratory-developed test, potentially subject to regulatory approval as a companion diagnostic.

products.name: Computer-Controlled Dental Anesthesia Delivery Systems
products.description: These are proprietary computer-controlled systems, such as the CompuDent and STA Single Tooth Anesthesia System, designed for the precise and painless delivery of local anesthetics in dental procedures. The systems include a reusable electronic instrument and single-use disposable handpieces, and are manufactured by third-party suppliers and distributed globally through direct sales and distributors.

products.name: Computer-Controlled Epidural Anesthesia Delivery Systems
products.description: These are advanced medical devices, such as the CompuFlo Epidural Computer Controlled Anesthesia System, that use Dynamic Pressure Sensing technology to provide real-time feedback for accurate needle placement and controlled drug delivery during epidural procedures. The systems are manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold to hospitals and clinics through direct and distributor channels.

products.name: Disposable Injection Handpieces for Dental and Medical Systems
products.description: Single-use, disposable handpieces designed for use with the company's computer-controlled dental and medical drug delivery systems, providing precise tactile control and minimizing cross-contamination. These are manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold as consumables alongside the main systems.

products.name: Grain and Agricultural Commodity Merchandising
products.description: The company buys, sells, and manages logistics for whole grains, grain products, feed ingredients, and other agricultural commodities, primarily corn, wheat, and soybeans. This involves physical handling, storage, and transportation using a network of grain elevators and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Agricultural Nutrient Products
products.description: Manufactures, distributes, and retails bulk fertilizers and specialized high-value plant nutrient products for agricultural, industrial, and consumer markets. Production involves physical manufacturing and distribution through a broad network.

products.name: Grain Storage and Elevation Services
products.description: Operates grain elevators providing storage, conditioning, and elevation services for agricultural commodities, earning fees and margins from storage and handling for third parties and from trading activities.

products.name: Grain Marketing and Risk Management Services
products.description: Offers grain marketing, risk management, and origination services to agricultural producers and ethanol plants, collecting fees for these advisory and transactional services. These are primarily digital and relationship-based services.

products.name: Ethanol and Biofuels Production and Sales
products.description: Produces, purchases, and sells ethanol and other biofuels through company-owned and managed plants, involving large-scale physical manufacturing, plant management, and logistics. Also includes commercialization and trading of ethanol and co-products.

products.name: Ethanol and Biofuels Merchandising and Trading
products.description: Operates a merchandising and trade portfolio for ethanol, ethanol co-products, and renewable feedstocks, involving buying, selling, and logistics management for these products in the market.

products.name: Retail Electricity Supply
products.description: Provision of electricity to approximately 5 million residential, commercial, and industrial customers across 16 states and the District of Columbia, primarily through branded subsidiaries. Delivered via regulated transmission infrastructure, sourced from internal generation and wholesale markets.

products.name: Retail Natural Gas Supply
products.description: Provision of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in select markets, delivered through regulated pipelines and distribution networks, often bundled with electricity offerings.

products.name: Electricity Generation (Wholesale Power Sales)
products.description: Generation and wholesale sale of electricity from a diverse fleet of natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar, and battery energy storage facilities totaling approximately 44,000 MW, sold into competitive wholesale power markets across the U.S.

products.name: Capacity and Ancillary Services
products.description: Provision of capacity and ancillary services (such as regulation, reserves, and reliability products) to Independent System Operators (ISOs) and Regional Transmission Organizations (RTOs), supporting grid reliability and market operations. Delivered via physical generation assets and energy storage systems.

products.name: Renewable Energy and Battery Storage Solutions
products.description: Generation and sale of electricity from company-owned solar and battery energy storage facilities, as well as offering 100% wind and solar retail options to customers. Involves physical assets and digital management platforms.

products.name: Energy Efficiency and Demand Response Programs
products.description: Provision of programs and tools (such as thermostats, dashboards, and consumption reduction incentives) to retail customers to encourage reduced electricity usage and increased energy efficiency. Delivered via digital platforms and customer engagement.

products.name: Commodity Risk Management Services
products.description: Offering of commodity risk management and hedging services related to electricity, natural gas, and other energy commodities, primarily to manage price volatility for internal operations but may include external counterparties in wholesale markets. Delivered via financial contracts and trading expertise.

products.name: Dropbox Platform (Cloud Content Collaboration and Storage)
products.description: A cloud-based platform that provides individuals and organizations with a unified workspace to create, store, access, organize, share, and collaborate on digital content. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, it includes file syncing, sharing, version history, search, and integrations with third-party applications.

products.name: Dropbox Backup
products.description: A cloud backup service that automatically syncs and backs up folders from users’ computers to the cloud, ensuring files are continuously protected and recoverable from any device. Delivered as a SaaS feature or add-on.

products.name: Dropbox Sign (eSignature and Document Workflow)
products.description: A web and mobile-based eSignature and document workflow platform that enables customers to sign, send, and receive documents electronically, with automatic syncing to Dropbox accounts. Delivered as a SaaS product.

products.name: DocSend (Secure Document Sharing and Analytics)
products.description: A secure document sharing and analytics platform that allows users to share documents with advanced security controls and track recipient engagement. Delivered as a SaaS product.

products.name: Dropbox Dash (AI-Powered Universal Search)
products.description: An AI-powered universal search tool that enables users to find, organize, share, and manage content across Dropbox and connected third-party applications from a single interface. Delivered as a SaaS feature or add-on.

products.name: Dropbox Transfer
products.description: A service that enables users to send large files or collections of files securely to anyone, providing recipients with copies while keeping the sender’s originals intact. Delivered as a SaaS feature or add-on.

products.name: Dropbox Paper (Collaborative Document Creation)
products.description: A collaborative document creation tool that allows users to co-author, edit, and organize content in real-time, supporting rich media, timelines, and task management. Delivered as a SaaS feature within the Dropbox platform.

products.name: FormSwift (Business Forms and Agreements)
products.description: A cloud-based service for creating, completing, editing, and saving business forms and agreements, targeted at individuals and businesses. Delivered as a SaaS product.

products.name: Reclaim (AI-Powered Scheduling Tool)
products.description: An AI-powered scheduling tool that helps companies prioritize tasks and coordinate schedules with calendar applications. Delivered as a SaaS product or integration.

products.name: IGF-1R Antibody Therapies for Thyroid Eye Disease (TED)
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapeutics (veligrotug for intravenous administration and elegrobart for subcutaneous administration) targeting IGF-1R, developed through biologics manufacturing and clinical trials, for the treatment of active and chronic TED. Delivered via infusion or auto-injector for at-home use.

products.name: FcRn Inhibitor Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Engineered biologic therapeutics (VRDN-006 and VRDN-008) that inhibit the neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn), developed for subcutaneous self-administration, targeting a broad array of autoimmune diseases. These are produced via protein engineering and biologics manufacturing.

products.name: TSHR Inhibitor Therapies for Graves’ Disease and TED
products.description: Half-life extended monoclonal antibody therapeutics targeting the thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor (TSHR), developed for subcutaneous administration via autoinjector, intended to treat Graves’ disease and TED. These are produced through biologics manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Soup Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed under brands such as Campbell’s and Chunky, these include condensed and ready-to-serve soups, produced in company-owned facilities and distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Broth, Stocks, and Canned Poultry
products.description: Includes Swanson and Pacific Foods branded broths, stocks, and canned poultry, produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Pasta Sauces and Italian Meals
products.description: Manufactured pasta sauces and Italian meal products under brands such as Prego, Rao's, and Michael Angelo’s, including dry pasta, frozen entrées, frozen pizza, and dinner sauces, distributed through retail and foodservice.

products.name: Mexican Sauces and Salsas
products.description: Includes Pace branded Mexican sauces, produced in company facilities and distributed to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Shelf-Stable Pasta and Beans
products.description: Includes SpaghettiOs pasta and Campbell’s branded beans, manufactured as shelf-stable meal options and distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Juices and Non-Dairy Beverages
products.description: Manufactured juices and non-dairy beverages under brands such as V8, Campbell's tomato juice, and Pacific Foods, produced in company facilities and distributed through retail and foodservice.

products.name: Bakery Products
products.description: Includes Pepperidge Farm branded cookies, crackers, and fresh bakery items, manufactured in company-owned bakeries and distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Snack Foods
products.description: Manufactured and marketed snack foods including Goldfish crackers, Snyder’s of Hanover pretzels, Lance sandwich crackers, Cape Cod and Kettle Brand potato chips, Late July snacks, and Snack Factory pretzel crisps, distributed primarily through retail and direct-store-delivery channels.

products.name: Supply Chain Management Services (Total Supply Management™)
products.description: Comprehensive supply chain management outsourcing service for production components, including sourcing, procurement, logistics, inventory management, engineering support, and just-in-time delivery, delivered through a global network of logistics service centers and customized information systems.

products.name: Precision Cold-Formed and Cold-Extruded Fasteners and Components
products.description: Engineering and manufacturing of precision cold-formed and cold-extruded fasteners and specialty hardware, including locknuts, bolts, and wheel hardware, produced in high volumes for automotive, heavy-duty truck, and aerospace industries.

products.name: Automotive and Industrial Assembly Components
products.description: Design, development, and manufacturing of fuel rails, fuel filler assemblies, extruded and molded rubber and plastic components, and turbo charging/coolant hoses for automotive and industrial applications, produced in dedicated manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Induction Heating and Melting Systems
products.description: Engineering, construction, service, and repair of induction heating and melting systems for metals processing, coatings, forging, and foundry industries, utilizing proprietary technology and built to customer specifications in global manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Pipe Threading Systems
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of pipe threading systems primarily for the oil and gas industry, delivered as capital equipment and supported by field service and spare parts.

products.name: Forged and Machined Products
products.description: Manufacturing of forged steel and machined products, including mechanical forging presses, crankshafts, camshafts, aerospace and defense structural components, and rail products, produced in domestic and international facilities for OEMs and industrial customers.

products.name: SLK (Tri-specific IL-17A and IL-17F Inhibiting Nanobody Therapeutic)
products.description: A proprietary, subcutaneously administered Nanobody biologic therapy targeting IL-17A and IL-17F, developed and manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations, intended for treatment of inflammatory skin and joint diseases such as hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), palmoplantar pustulosis (PPP), axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), and potentially other IL-17-driven conditions. Delivery is via injection, with planned commercial launch subject to regulatory approval.

products.name: Filtration Products for Vehicles and Equipment
products.description: Atmus designs and manufactures advanced filtration products, including fuel filters, lube filters, air filters, crankcase ventilation, hydraulic filters, and related filtration systems, primarily for on-highway commercial vehicles and off-highway agriculture, construction, mining, and power generation vehicles and equipment. These products are physically manufactured and delivered both as first-fit components to OEMs and as aftermarket replacement parts.

products.name: Industrial Filtration Solutions
products.description: Atmus develops and supplies filtration solutions for industrial markets beyond vehicles, leveraging its filtration technology and manufacturing capabilities to serve applications such as industrial systems, hydrogen production, and electric powered vehicles. These solutions are produced using proprietary filtration media and systems integration.

products.name: Coolants and Related Chemicals
products.description: Atmus manufactures and sells coolants and other chemicals used in vehicle and equipment maintenance, providing asset protection and supporting engine performance. These are physical products distributed through the same channels as filtration products.

products.name: Remote Digital Diagnostic and Prognostic Platforms
products.description: Atmus offers digital platforms and analytics services for remote diagnostics and prognostics of filtration systems, enabling customers to monitor and optimize equipment performance. These are digital solutions developed by Atmus’ technical team and delivered as value-added services to end-users.
